own_solution.law: Moving-reflector Doppler: f_echo = f (c+v)/(c-v); beat = 2 f v/(c-v)
assumptions: source and microphone at rest together
wall moves directly towards source at constant speed

defect_reasons.other: T7F76's pluperfect 'had added 1.4 m/s ... before the echo was recorded' only implicitly says the extra speed persists during the recording, and sits slightly against the base 'constant speed of 3 m/s'; the intended reading is clear enough.

notes: Verified the C cancellation derivation: t_n = (q + c n/f)/(c+v), T_n = t_n + (q - v t_n)/c = (t_n(c-v)+q)/c, so T_(n+1)-T_n = (c-v)/(f(c+v)) independent of q. R answers: v=3.7 -> 3256/339.3 = 9.5962; v=4.4 -> 3872/338.6 = 11.4353; v=5.2 -> 4576/337.8 = 13.5465 Hz; all match. Minimal pairs T105F/T2729 and T811A/T7F76 share 1.4 m/s and differ only in attachment/time; numeral-free twins T544D/T105F and T1B41/T811A as described; T72F4/TAC5B both 90 m. Agrees with pass 1 (where I had chosen C for the distance).
